scope: Trainability smoke test for the rank-4 flower-task VACE LoRA
summary: One bounded epoch completed all 12 steps on the selected A800 and produced a reproducible LoRA checkpoint; this is working only as a trainer execution smoke test.
evidence: Training completed 12/12 steps with return code 0 in approximately 31 seconds.
The output checkpoint is 5,503,040 bytes with SHA-256 6f1e7fec93f761278298630745383f6a0508daf1dd703c4aef7eb0bc8995ae00.
Run metadata preserves GPU inventory, configuration, dataset manifest, DiffSynth commit, package versions, and checkpoint hashes.
lessons: The pinned DiffSynth VACE path can train a small regional task adapter within the declared GPU budget.
limitations: The log exposes no useful loss curve, uses only 12 synthetic clips, and includes a kernel-version and process-group cleanup warning.
Successful optimization does not establish any image or contact quality.
